_comment: Curated text fixes that survive DB re-exports. export_data.py applies each 'summaries' rule to the WHOLE card of any record whose episode_title/title/insight_title contains 'episode_title' (every string field except the title fields: summary, key_takeaway(s), investment_thesis, notable_quotes quote+speaker, Deep Dive overview/episode_evidence/falsification_tracks, ...) in podcast_summaries.json, archive.json and data.js (archive, mainContent, deepDives). 'drop_tickers' removes symbols from tickers_mentioned/key_tickers of matched records. 'global_replacements' are exact swaps applied to every non-title string everywhere (incl. pundits, overton speakers, podcastGuests). 'terms' rules overwrite fields of suggestedTerms entries whose term matches exactly. Replacements are exact substring swaps; once the DB text is fixed they become no-ops. Oct 2026: 'bet' wording swaps (Jared's rule: nothing on the public site is called a bet) live in global_replacements; site_text_sanitize style gate warns on any new ones. 'name_replacements' (Oct 13 2026 whole-site name sweep) are exact name swaps applied like global_replacements but quote-safe: never inside quotation marks, notable_quotes quote text, transcript-style episode_evidence lines, last_proof_snippet/cite, titles, slugs or URLs. 'drop_tickers' also removes symbols from Deep Dive ticker_analysis. Oct 14 2026 (Red Team): 'ticker_renames' and 'global_drop_tickers' fix fake/defunct/private symbols in tickers_mentioned, key_tickers and ticker_analysis on every card; per-card 'rename_tickers' for context-dependent symbols. Oct 20 2026: a 'summaries' rule may carry 'podcast_episode_id' (+ optional 'insight_id') to match that episode's cards by id instead of title text; 'drop_quotes' removes notable_quotes entries whose quote contains a given substring. 'title_overrides' retitle one episode by id (insight/Deep Dive/podcast-summary title fields, Overton first/last_mentioned_episode_title by episode id, pundit/guest last_episode_title and last_proof_cite by podcast + date + old title); never a global string swap. Oct 20 2026 (pundit sweep): 'pundit_excludes' drop placeholder/non-person pundit rows from every exported pundit list by pundit id (DB rows kept); 'pundit_overrides' set fields and apply whole-word (hyphen-aware) swaps on one pundit row by id, after the global name swaps. Oct 20 2026 (G decisions): 'pundit_merges' [{keep, merge:[ids]}] fold duplicate pundit rows into the kept row (latest appearance fields, combined count without double counting, Presence recomputed); merged-away ids are also in 'pundit_excludes'. 'pundit_overrides' may 'unset' keys. Host rows are also hidden by pundit_exclusions.is_excluded_pundit (ids + corrected-name check) after all name overrides.

His work has had a significant impact on the way businesses approach data analytics and machine learning.
